Guild Overview

Legendary was established in order to form a tight knit group of players, that can progress and level up and become friends with each other. Legendary's current recruiting guidelines are a player must be lv 35+ before he/she can get into Legendary. This is to limit the level range of our players, forming a tighter group of players, so its easier to find people your level to group up with.

Basic Ranking Guidelines:
Level 35-49: Rank 3
Level 50-59: Rank 4
Level 60-69: Rank 5
Level 70-79: Rank 6
Level 80-100: Rank 7
Promotions are based on level advancement, amount of people you recruit to Legendary, and how you respect the rules and guidelines
